restated_task: Refactor kvparse/parser.py to replace the manual index loops in parse_line with str.partition, stripping, and quote removal, while preserving all existing behavior for string inputs. Additionally, extract the logic for detecting ignorable lines (blank, comment starting with '#' or ';') into a private module-level function _is_ignorable and use it in parse. The public functions parse and parse_line must remain exported and behave identically for all string inputs, including same return values, same exception types (TypeError for non-string input to parse, ValueError for malformed lines), duplicate key handling, and quote stripping rules. The existing test suite must continue to pass unchanged.

interface_contract.name: parse_line
interface_contract.behavior: Splits the input line at the first '=' character using str.partition. The key is the part before '=', stripped of surrounding whitespace. The value is the part after '=', stripped of surrounding whitespace. If the stripped value has length >= 2 and starts and ends with the same quote character (either '"' or "'"), the surrounding quotes are removed (only one pair). Returns a tuple (key, value).
error_cases: ValueError: raised when the line contains no '=' character, or when the stripped key is empty.

interface_contract.name: parse
interface_contract.behavior: Parses the input text into a dictionary. The text is split into lines (using splitlines). For each line, if _is_ignorable(line) returns True, the line is skipped. Otherwise, parse_line is called on the original line (not stripped) and the resulting key-value pair is added to the dictionary, with later duplicate keys overwriting earlier ones. Returns the resulting dictionary.
error_cases: TypeError: raised when text is not a string.
ValueError: raised when any non-ignorable line causes parse_line to raise ValueError (i.e., malformed line).

acceptance_criteria: 12. parse_line('k e y = v') returns ('k e y', 'v').
14. parse_line raises ValueError for empty string ''.
16. parse_line raises ValueError for ' = v' (empty key after stripping).
17. parse_line raises ValueError for '   ' (only whitespace, no '=').
19. parse_line raises ValueError for '\t= 1' (key empty after stripping).

23. parse('# comment

; other
name = x
') returns {'name': 'x'} (comments and blank lines ignored).
27. parse raises TypeError for non-string input (e.g., None, 3, [], b'bytes').
33. parse_line contains no 'while' loop and uses str.partition.
34. The existing test suite (tests/test_parser.py) passes without modification.
